# incusos_system_fallback_listener (Resource)

Manages the IncusOS fallback HTTPS listener (`/1.0/system/fallback-listener`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `listen_address` (String) IP:port or :port address to listen on. If omitted, listens on all interfaces on a random port.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Always start the fallback listener at boot rather than only when the primary application is unavailable.
- `trusted_client_certificates` (List of String) List of PEM-encoded trusted client TLS certificates allowed to connect to the fallback listener.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the fallback listener is currently active.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
